videos.desc: In a cel-animated kitchen, a man fills the sink to wash dishes but looks away, and the foamy water rises over the rim and pours onto the floor. He rushes back to shut the tap and stands sheepishly in a big puddle.

In a Ghibli-style anime laundry room, a red-haired girl loads her big red sweater into the washing machine, then pulls it out again shrunk to doll size and holds the tiny sweater up in horrified disbelief.

On a seaside terrace at sunset, a couple throws a white tablecloth high into the air, lets it float down over a wooden table, smooths it flat and then sets plates and glasses on top; a cat walks across at the end.
videos.said: Three, up and over. Smooth, perfect.

videos.desc: A back garden with a large above-ground pool standing on a wide concrete patio, its slabs marked out by straight joint lines. A young man in sunglasses lies on a patterned Persian rug spread on the concrete, propped on one elbow under a small black umbrella, sipping an orange drink through a straw. Behind him another man in a white T-shirt scrubs the wet concrete with a long-handled deck brush, pushing white soapy foam across the slabs. More rugs lie drying on the concrete and the whole patio is covered in suds and water.

A man in a light blue shirt stands at the white wall units of a bright kitchen with a patterned tile splashback. He opens the doors of an empty cupboard and shows the bare wooden shelves. He then puts the dishes away shelf by shelf: stacks of coloured plates, nests of green and blue bowls, a pile of purple plates lifted up from below. He closes the doors, opens them again, and the cupboard is now full — rainbow stacks of plates and bowls on the lower shelf and rows of coloured preserving jars along the upper one. He steps back and looks at it.

A woman in a bright patterned headwrap appears in three scenes. First she smiles as she posts a folded white paper through the slot of a grey ballot box in a bright classroom. Then she is in a park with two other women, working a long litter-picker to lift a plastic bottle and other thrown-away rubbish off the grass into the green bags they hold open. Then she stands outside a government building under a row of flags, opens a blue passport, reads it, hugs it to her chest and laughs, and finally walks through a busy city square still holding it.

A small Japanese flat crammed with things. A woman in a yellow apron works along a wooden shelf unit with a spray bottle and a cloth, taking down bottles and folded cloths. The floor around her is covered in clothes and open cardboard boxes; she bends down and packs armfuls of them away. Next she wipes a low wooden table with a blue cloth. The room is then shown from the door: the shelves are empty, the floor is bare, sunlight falls across the boards. She drops onto the sofa on her back, mouth open, done in.

A woman with curly hair and a knotted headband leans over a glass coffee table loaded with remote controls, magazines, tubes and sprays, scrubbing the glass with a white cloth. Spray bottles stand around her. She moves to the sofa and pulls the seat cushions straight, punching them back into shape. The living room is then shown from the doorway, empty and bare, with sun on the parquet and one rag left on the floor. She sits down on the sofa, leans back, stretches her legs out and stays there, looking round the finished room.

Four short shots of people cleaning, each built around the kit they use. A woman in yellow rubber gloves pushes a blue sponge in circles through soapy water on a white kitchen worktop. A man in a grey uniform swings a round spin mop on a yellow pole across a glossy office floor while staff work at desks behind him. A window cleaner in a blue hard hat, orange safety harness and white gloves draws a squeegee down a skyscraper pane from a hanging cradle, the city far below. A man in a grey T-shirt bends over a wooden floor in an empty flat with a cloth, buckets and bottles lined up behind him.

A bathroom after a haircut. The white basin, the marble counter and the mirror are smeared all over with clippings of black hair; loose hair is stuck to the glass and lies in drifts on the floor. A man in a white vest wipes the counter and the basin with a grey cloth, rinses it under the tap, then wipes the mirror clean in wide strokes. By the end the mirror is clear, the marble is bare and the basin is white again, with a single spray bottle standing on the counter.

A man opens the blue cap of a rainbow-coloured bottle in a laundry room and pours thick blue liquid from it into the measuring cap. He pulls out the drawer of a white front-loading washing machine and tips the blue liquid in, then closes the drawer and starts the machine, which we see running with washing turning inside. At the end he holds up a clean white t-shirt and smiles.

On a sunny rooftop terrace above a deep blue sea, a grey-haired woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron hangs white washing on a rope line. She shakes out a white shirt, pegs it up, straightens it with both hands, and at the end lifts a white cloth to her nose, closes her eyes and breathes in the smell of it.

A tiled terrace high above the sea. A white shirt hangs from a wooden peg on a line, moving in the wind. An older woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron lifts more white washing onto the line, pegs a white garment up with both hands, then gathers an armful of clean white clothes against her chest and looks out at the water, laughing.

A wrecked kitchen is cleaned up. Spray foam is squirted over a black stove top covered in dried food, then a woman stacks dirty bowls and plates from a counter buried in washing-up, then a hand rubs a folded cloth over the white worktop in circles, and the last shots pan across the same kitchen completely clean and empty.
videos.said: Wow, you cleaned this whole messy kitchen so well.

videos.desc: A woman in a kitchen runs a steam iron over a white shirt spread on an ironing board by the window. Cut to a bedroom, where a man in a blue polo presses a pair of dark trousers laid flat across the end of the bed. Then an older woman at a wooden dining table works the iron over a stack of grey linen napkins. Next two women stand at opposite sides of a long table in a bright loft and run an iron each over a big white sheet. Finally the two of them hold the finished sheet up between them, hanging smooth and flat.

In a high-rise office a woman in a dark uniform, yellow rubber gloves and yellow shoes pushes a flat mop across a wide stone floor. The floor she has already done throws back a clear mirror image of the ceiling lights and the windows. Behind a glass wall a meeting is going on at a long table with people in suits, none of whom look up. She works her way backwards across the hall, leaving one long polished strip after another.

A cup under a coffee machine has filled past the brim and coffee is running out over the black worktop and pouring off the edge onto the kitchen floor. A young man in a purple hoodie rushes in and finds the kitchen sink filled to overflowing, the tap still running and white foam and water sheeting down the cupboard doors onto the tiles. He runs down the hallway to the bathroom, where the bathtub is full to the rim and a wall of foam is pouring over the side and spreading across the floor. He stands in the doorway with his hands in his hair, shouting, as the foam keeps rising out of the tub.

On a sunny rooftop deck, a young man in a white vest and cream shorts lies in a rope hammock with his eyes closed, holding a small brown dog on his chest. Behind him, by the wooden fence, a paint tin stands on a stool, and a young woman in a red zip jacket, white crop top and denim shorts stands with her hands on her hips, frowning down at him. He opens his eyes, grins, and pulls a cap down over his face, and she throws up one hand in frustration. String lights hang above.

Inside a launderette with a black and white checked floor, turquoise and pink tiles and neon lights, a tall chestnut horse with a halter and a long lead rope stands holding a striped sock in its mouth. Next to it a young woman with curly hair in a pink top and denim shorts bends over by an open washing machine, pulls out a white towel and laughs, looking at the horse. The view moves back from the horse's head to show the whole room with its orange plastic chairs and a potted plant.

At an old wooden chalet in a sunny mountain village, a smiling young woman in a white shirt leans out over an upstairs balcony rail and shakes a big white duvet out into the fresh air, flapping it up and down and laughing. Pillows hang on the wall beside her, a striped rug hangs on the rail next to red geraniums, and below, an older woman in a striped cardigan arranges pillows while a cat sits beside her. A church tower with an onion dome and snowy peaks rise in the background.

At the open doors of an old wooden barn on a sunny day, dust hangs in the light as a young man in a grey shirt walks out carrying a large mounted moose head with antlers on his shoulder and a wooden chair in his other hand. A rolled-up old carpet lies on the ground with a beagle resting on it. The barn behind him is almost empty. Outside, people sort piles of boxes, old televisions and furniture next to a red tractor and a white farmhouse.

A sunny beach. A shirtless young man in navy swim shorts stands knee-deep in clear sea water behind an ironing board, lifts a steaming iron and presses a white shirt with it, then holds the shirt up by its edges. Behind him ironed shirts hang on hangers from a striped beach umbrella. People float on inflatable rings and stare, a man in the water gasps, others sunbathe on the sand, and a group plays volleyball further up the beach.

A row of red-brick terraced houses on a sunny autumn day, with a blue and a green front door side by side. In the front garden on the left, a young woman with a long red braid, a blue jumper and yellow wellies sprays water from a garden hose over the low white fence. In the garden right beside hers, a young man in a grey T-shirt gets soaked, then points his leaf blower down and blows a storm of orange leaves back at her. A tabby cat sits on the fence and a woman waves from an upstairs window.

A retro kitchen with wooden cupboards and patterned wallpaper. A young woman in a blue jumper and cream skirt stands calmly and pours orange juice from a glass jug straight down, watching it with a small smile. A young man in a burgundy shirt crouches in front of her holding out a tea towel to catch it, but the juice soaks through and splashes onto the speckled floor. She stops pouring and smiles at him while he looks up at her in disbelief. A kettle and a hob are behind them.

A cream camper van parked in a sunny farmyard beside an old stone barn. A young woman in a blue sports top and black shorts scrubs the side of the van with a big yellow sponge, smiling. Only the patch she has already washed is clean and wet; the rest of the van is still covered in grey dust and dirt. A young man in a white T-shirt crouches beside her pouring water from one metal bucket into another, then lifts a bucket up to her. Water runs down onto the wet concrete.
